info.name: Consignment ERP Lite — API
info.description: REST API for the Consignment / Van Sales / Route Accounting backend. All money fields are decimal strings (precision 18, scale 2). All ids are BigInt-as-string. Authenticated endpoints require a Bearer JWT obtained from `/api/v1/auth/login`.

request.description: Login with username + password and obtain JWT
Consignment stock currently held by a customer
Visit + sale history for a customer
Compute live credit exposure for a customer
List product lots (FEFO source-of-truth) with per-location balances
Adjust warehouse stock (manual delta) — creates a WAREHOUSE_ADJUSTMENT movement
Load stock to a customer (or replenish). Credit-checked.
Return stock from a customer back to the warehouse
Get visit detail including items, collections, and AR invoices
Record per-SKU counts + replenish intents (qty_sold/sales_amount computed)
Atomic confirm: SALE_CONFIRMED + REPLENISHMENT + collection / AR invoice
Standalone collection that settles outstanding AR FIFO by due_date
Record a payment against a specific invoice
Preview a load and check whether the projected exposure would exceed the limit
Customers near or above their credit limit
Dead stock alert (no SALE_CONFIRMED within N days)
Suggested production quantities based on avg daily sales
Slim profile of the calling user
Today's visits for the calling rep, with current consignment stock
Batch check-in + record-items in a single call (network-friendly)
Get a (stubbed) presigned PUT URL for visit / product photos
